states.narration: The same sum x+4 appears in both terms. Each multiplier is written after its group: first two, then five.
Collect the identical group on the left and add its multipliers on the right, in the order two then five. No factor needs to switch sides.
Evaluate two plus five as seven. The multiplier stays on the right, and the entire sum x+4 stays unchanged on the left.

editorial.title: Keep the multipliers on the right
editorial.setup: Find the repeated group x+4. This time its multipliers follow the parentheses; keep that order as you collect the two terms.
editorial.summary: The repeated sum remains x+4 while its right-hand multipliers combine as two plus five. We found their total, seven, without evaluating x+4 or swapping factors.
